## Testing Mode
GREEN

## Story DD Coverage
- dd-1: AGENTS.md includes dso:visual-evaluator entry (already done in B3 — verify still present)
- dd-2: CONFIGURATION-REFERENCE.md includes all visual_evaluator.* config keys (already done in B6 — verify still present)
- dd-3: Unit tests pass

## Implementation Notes
Most documentation updates have been incrementally added during sprint:
- B3: AGENTS.md got dso:visual-evaluator entry
- B6: CONFIGURATION-REFERENCE.md got visual_evaluator.* section

This task verifies the docs are consistent across the merged code on origin/main and adds any missing references.

Verify and add (if missing):
- AGENTS.md: dso:visual-evaluator entry
- CONFIGURATION-REFERENCE.md: visual_evaluator.* keys including post_batch_token_hard_stop_multiplier, route_map_max_age_hours, dimension_weights, cache_max_entries, iteration_cap, iteration_threshold
- Optionally add to plugins/dso/skills/sprint/SKILL.md a brief reference to Integration A and B sections

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass (exit 0)
  Verify: python3 -m pytest tests/
- [ ] Lint passes (exit 0)
  Verify: ruff check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py tests/**/*.py
- [ ] Format check passes (exit 0)
  Verify: ruff format --check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py tests/**/*.py
- [ ] AGENTS.md references dso:visual-evaluator
  Verify: grep -q 'dso:visual-evaluator' plugins/dso/docs/AGENTS.md
- [ ] CONFIGURATION-REFERENCE.md has all visual_evaluator.* keys
  Verify: for k in iteration_cap iteration_threshold post_batch_token_budget route_map_max_age_hours dimension_weights; do grep -q "visual_evaluator.$k" plugins/dso/docs/CONFIGURATION-REFERENCE.md || exit 1; done

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet)
